description: Open source AI code review for coding agents. A separate reviewer checks every change your agent writes before you push, in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Cline. No account or key of its own.
summary: Open source AI code review for Claude Code and Codex, before you push. Scanners (SAST, secrets, dependencies, lint) on the lines you changed, then a separate reviewer process that checks every scanner finding and is given every changed line. No other API key.
